app.name: 5 Minutes Journal
app.description: A display-only five-minute journal built from your morning and evening check-ins with Notis. Browse daily mood, energy, motivation, gratitude, intentions, affirmations, highlights, lessons, and free-form reflections, then use Stats to see trends and ritual consistency over time.
